description: Reviewed second (contract) steps of expand-then-contract API changes. CI (scripts/check-foundation-update-order.mjs, job foundation-replay) fails when a pull request removes or renames an API command or argument, changes an argument or return type, makes an argument required or removes an execute grant, unless an entry added in that same pull request matches it (command, change and argument or role). An entry already on the base commit authorises nothing more; a later change of the same kind needs a new entry with its own expand update. Each entry names the earlier expand update and its pull request: that update must already be on main and recorded as applied in main's updates/README.md register, a replacement must already exist on main, and a removed command must no longer be named in src/ or workers/. Reverting an expand step that production never received needs no entry. Changes: remove, remove-argument, argument-type, require-argument, returns, revoke. Fields inside jsonb values and argument defaults are not compared.
